scope.description: shouldSnapshot (snapshot.go 106-120) as called by runSnapshots, for a node whose log store's last index is at or below its last snapshot index.
assumptions: The LogStore and SnapshotStore are the injected implementations; the restore path and the trigger are the unmodified library code.
The configured SnapshotThreshold is a positive value (the default is used).
excluded: The snapshot contents, the FSM snapshot contract and the durability of the injected stores.
The installSnapshot watermark behaviour that also puts a node into this state, which is a separate confirmed obligation.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: The node is built with the internal skipStartup flag so no background loop races the direct call to the periodic trigger; the trigger function, the stores, the snapshot store and the restore path are the unmodified implementation.
The snapshot payload is a genuine msgpack FSM snapshot produced with the package's own encoder so MockFSM.Restore succeeds, and the default SnapshotThreshold is used unchanged.

plan_uncertainties: The check evaluates the trigger's decision only; it does not run the snapshotter to observe the follow-on snapshot, so the consequence is characterized as redundant repeated snapshots rather than measured.
The fixture uses a restart-restore with an empty log store; the installSnapshot route to the same state is covered by the separate confirmed check and is not re-exercised here.
grounding_unresolved: Whether the redundant snapshot has effects beyond wasted work.
Which store/history combinations other than the monotonic install path and the cleared-log restart reach the state.
Whether the repeated snapshot the trigger causes on such a node has any effect other than redundant work is not exercised; the check only evaluates the trigger's decision.
